source: a plain-text request with a method the HTTP decoder does not know (PROPFIND) goes down the binary path, which logs its bytes as hex and as UTF-8 text (BinaryRequestProxyingHandler). 8.0.0 quotes its Authorization header in full there with redactSecretsInLog on; upstream c76143e4a (adopted after 8.0.0) logs those payloads as SensitiveLogValue, masked when redaction is on (BinaryPlainTextRedactionIntegrationTest). The steps marked "diverge" check our fixed answer; the goldens keep 8.0.0's.

steps.note: an unknown method on a connection of its own: the binary path answers with the unknown-format text

tcp.text:
PROPFIND /dav HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost
Authorization: Bearer PROPFIND-SECRET-TOKEN-999

steps.note: plain-text LOGS: neither the credential nor its hex
LOG_ENTRIES: the arguments are masked too
